subject: [NAME] - Fraud Patterns
text:
Hi [NAME],

When speaking with fraud prevention leaders, we often hear that in-house
data management tools are ineffective and painful to maintain.

Encord is an ML Ops platform trusted by leading IDV teams to power fraud
detection workflows through advanced data curation, embedding-based search,
and clustering - driving higher model accuracy and deeper visibility into
emerging fraud patterns.

I'd love to explore how we could solve similar challenges for [COMPANY] - would
you be open to learning more?
